text: opened the forest of vinesauce for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; group 1 (a gate failed at B1c)

B1d room vinesauce (order 598, group 1: the B1c test found the gate failing in t08, T3-074 against T3-136) reread: A1 note, 9 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (35 threads, 213 lines, not cut). One change, a bag (out/_analysis/b1d06_bags_vinesauce.txt, checked with b1_precheck_bagfile.py and b1_check_bags.py; two tier lines written, tier_history 107; multiplacement 6,654): t08 (working out what this small group can manage) held T3-074 with T3-069 and T3-181; the B1c failure is real here, since the label is the room weighing its own capacity and three concepts doubt it (c0077, whether the room has the teamwork to put one of its greatest memes on the canvas, asked before a new build; c0049, the sub called too weak; c0086, the plans called impossible with so few people), doubting the room is strong enough (T3-136), beside coping with few hands while building (c0040, c0076, T3-074). With four kinds it is now one placement in T3-074 with T3-069, T3-181 and T3-136 in the bag line; T3-069 and T3-181 were unplaced. For B1e, the T3-074/T3-136 discriminator should say that doubting whether the room can manage a work at all goes to T3-136 even when it comes during the work, and that working around the timer and too few hands while building goes to T3-074; scp t02 (B1d-04) stays in T3-074 on its own concepts. Carrying codes: c0024 (the Homestuck builders agreeing to go behind the shroom) and c0078 (mutual protection offered with r/nyjets) are carried by T3-010 and T3-150 in t06; c0043 by T3-010 in t06 as a warning to move. For the T3-188 gate on outside voices: c0043, an r/France member saying their own equivalent of 4chan is destroying everything on the French flag that is not French, with c0098 relaying it and c0058 (r/homestuck) blaming rogue French trolls; france t07's bag holds the same event from France's side (france c0280, missing from that bag, B1d-05; E1066). Named here, beside themes that hold three kinds: t01 T3-002 (c0006, c0062) and T3-004 (c0075, c0085); t06 T3-040 (c0055, the apology for painting over the Jets logo; c0089, to Homestuck) and T3-149 (c0017, an uneasy peace with the French after their encroachment, by the math t04 discriminator a truce; c0051 and c0100 propose building beside Green Lattice with no fight, T3-010); single concepts t02 T3-003 (c0027), t05 T3-029 (c0057) and t07 T3-063 (c0104, a Grand Dad post removed under the expanded rules). National and political content read plainly: the French encroachment, protection from the void repaid with help on their baguette, an operation called against France and the loss called a declaration of war on France (c0014, c0025, c0031, c0047, c0099); German fire and r/placeDE's suggestion to move (c0054, c0061, c0066, c0103); Belgium's army demand, refused and withdrawn (c0072, c0073, c0102); a joke on a World War Web (c0101). Nothing left out or softened. The A1 note's not-this holds: the shroom that survived was a rebuild moved twice (c0052, c0061, c0070). No new kind; the run is not reset.

Process slip after the compaction: one write (an Edit to the helper's members field, from second_order to theme_id, and its diary call given --stage B1) ran before the head and stage file were read again; the reconciliation followed, then the bag.

April Fools in t01 follows the B1b-20 rule: the sub's King's Quest switch and play inside it in T3-023; members' fakes (T3-001), objecting (c0004, c0040, c0148: T3-032) and joking (T3-031) in the bag. B1d room starcitizen (order 627, group 2: most hesitations in the first pass) reread: A1 note, 17 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (55 threads, 630 lines, not cut); no B1c line. No change. The A1 note's carrying codes: c0339 (scripts rejected because the Hornet should be built by people) is in T3-027 at t12; c0208 (help with Elite made official and reciprocal) is T3-151, in the t11 bag; c0223 (the KSP envoy offering a defence pact, a clean-up plan and a move of a neighbour's piece) is filed in the t11 bag reason under T3-010 itself, with the space alliance named in c0273. After the PI's split of T3-010 (B1b-19-p2), that envoy is T3-194 (acting as envoys between rooms; with c0270, KSP's P left as an ambassador) and the alliance is T3-150 (forming alliances between rooms; c0223, c0273, c0278, c0302, the last two inviting nearby rooms to a Discord against the void). Both kinds are missing from the existing t11 bag (kept T3-010 with T3-151, T3-024, T3-009, T3-005, T3-084, T3-021), each with a carrying code; recorded here, as at CKCrusaders t01 and homestuck t15. Also missing from that bag: T3-061 (c0274 the urge to expand and conquer, c0369 and c0370 taking more space as a neighbour's sign is removed). For the T3-188 gate (whether an outside voice counts): in t11 the room clears its ally of attacks made in the ally's name, calling them false-flag attacks meant to split the two rooms (c0309), saying the defacers are anti-SC people and not Elite's (c0307), and saying one provocateur who sided with Elite does not speak for its members (c0313); an Elite voice asks a Star Citizen placer to stop defacing Elite's logo (c0308). First-pass items for B1d, confirmed: t01 T3-097 (c0113, c0146); t04 T3-048 (c0072, c0127, c0128, c0130: the company's own past and wished-for April jokes; four concepts in an existing bag, so named here); t07 T3-016 (c0243 to c0249) and T3-181 (c0190, c0191); t08 T3-016 (c0170); t13 T3-037 (c0408, c0409) and T3-058 (c0312, c0379); t14 T3-087 (c0341, c0343); t16 T3-029 or T3-052 (c0397, c0399). Single peripheral concepts found now: t09 c0204 (the room judged weaker than other game subs of its size, for T3-136); t10 c0207 (sparing quality work, T3-024); t13 c0365 (a Rainbow Road maintainer pitching in on the ship, T3-011); t14 c0331 (a Discord channel asked for, T3-014). The T3-193 gate note from the first pass stands (t16: a joint logo with a rival game's room argued after the close). National and political content, named plainly: New Zealand attacked and its laser diverted (c0265, c0261, c0276, c0322); gratitude to Denmark weighed against room and the Danish flag defended in return (c0269, c0294); the Danish dispute called a civil war (c0374, t15 in T3-081); a vandalised Denmark name (c0318); asking Sweden for help against Denmark (c0401); Czechs helping stop Norway's attempt to take over Slovakia (c0317).
